label: 📋 Copy Ad · SENSITIVE review + arrows v1
brief: COPY AD — REFERENCE = Fang bad-breath ad (benefits with hand-drawn arrows around a centred product, tagline under it). Build a LACALUT SENSITIVE ad with THIS layout, 4:5
genPrompt:
COPY-AD REMAKE. The FIRST attached image is a proven, high-spending competitor Facebook ad. Recreate it as a NEAR-IDENTICAL remake for LACALUT Sensitive (German pharmacy oral care). Target: a viewer who saw both would say "same ad, different brand". KEEP EXACTLY (do not reinterpret, improve, re-compose or add to): the layout grid and every zone's position and size, the background, scene, props, people, poses, crops, camera angle, lighting, colour-blocking, type hierarchy, type sizes, text positions, alignment, badges, arrows, stickers, borders and overall finish. If it is a flat graphic, stay flat; if it is a photo, stay photographic; if it is UGC / lo-fi, stay lo-fi. BACKGROUND COLOUR — MANDATORY CHANGE (the ONE thing that is ALWAYS different from the reference): replace the reference's dominant background / card colour with soft pale teal-aqua #E3F2F3 (LACALUT Sensitive brand background). Keep the same background TYPE (flat card stays a flat card, gradient stays a gradient, photo scene stays a photo scene with its surfaces re-tinted toward this colour), same texture and lighting — only the hue changes. Re-tint any panel borders, pills or outlines that matched the old background so they still sit naturally on the new one. Text colours stay as the reference unless contrast fails, then darken/lighten minimally. SWAP ONLY: (a) their product → the attached LACALUT reference packshot, placed in the SAME spot, SAME scale, SAME angle and SAME lighting as their product (if their product is held, ours is held the same way); (b) their brand name, logo and wording → the LACALUT wording below. Where a line is marked "keep", reproduce it exactly; where it is rewritten, keep the SAME size, weight, colour, case and position for the new words. 

PRODUCTION SPEC OF THE REFERENCE AD (follow literally — this is the layout and copy to rebuild):
1. CANVAS:
Aspect ratio: Square (1:1).
Overall style: Flat graphic background with a photographic product and prop.
Dominant background: Solid light mint green.

2. LAYOUT GRID:
Headline and stars band: Top 22% of canvas height.
Product, props, and feature callouts band: Middle 60% of canvas height.
Product name and tagline band: Bottom 18% of canvas height.

3. TEXT — EVERY text element verbatim:
"I'm not" position: Top left of the headline band, approx. 15% from left edge, 5% from top edge. Size: Large. Weight: Regular. Case: Sentence case. Colour: Dark charcoal grey. Font style: Sans-serif. Alignment: Left. No background.
"worried about bad breath" position: Immediately to the right of "I'm not" on the same line. Size: Large. Weight: Bold. Case: Sentence case. Colour: Dark charcoal grey. Font style: Sans-serif. Alignment: Left. No background.
"anymore." position: Centered below "I'm not worried about bad breath". Size: Large. Weight: Bold. Case: Sentence case. Colour: Dark charcoal grey. Font style: Sans-serif. Alignment: Center. No background.
"PURE MINT TOOTHPASTE" position: Top center of the toothpaste tube. Size: Small. Weight: Regular. Case: All caps. Colour: Dark charcoal grey. Font style: Sans-serif, condensed. Alignment: Center. No background.
"nature + science" position: Upper middle of the toothpaste tube, below "PURE MINT TOOTHPASTE". Size: Small. Weight: Regular. Case: Sentence case. Colour: Dark charcoal grey. Font style: Sans-serif. Alignment: Center. No background.
"powered by" position: Below "nature + science" on the toothpaste tube. Size: Small. Weight: Regular. Case: Sentence case. Colour: Dark charcoal grey. Font style: Sans-serif. Alignment: Center. No background.
"n-HA & pure natural extracts" position: Below "powered by" on the toothpaste tube. Size: Small. Weight: Regular. Case: Sentence case. Colour: Dark charcoal grey. Font style: Sans-serif. Alignment: Center. No background.
"Gently Remineralises" position: Middle of the toothpaste tube, below the previous text block. Size: Small. Weight: Regular. Case: Sentence case. Colour: Dark charcoal grey. Font style: Sans-serif. Alignment: Center. No background.
"Anti-Cavity" position: Below "Gently Remineralises" on the toothpaste tube. Size: Small. Weight: Regular. Case: Sentence case. Colour: Dark charcoal grey. Font style: Sans-serif. Alignment: Center. No background.
"Anti-Plaque" position: Below "Anti-Cavity" on the toothpaste tube. Size: Small. Weight: Regular. Case: Sentence case. Colour: Dark charcoal grey. Font style: Sans-serif. Alignment: Center. No background.
"Anti-Sensitivity" position: Below "Anti-Plaque" on the toothpaste tube. Size: Small. Weight: Regular. Case: Sentence case. Colour: Dark charcoal grey. Font style: Sans-serif. Alignment: Center. No background.
"120 gm / 4.23 oz e" position: Bottom of the toothpaste tube, above the crimped end. Size: Small. Weight: Regular. Case: Sentence case. Colour: Dark charcoal grey. Font style: Sans-serif. Alignment: Center. No background.
"fang" position: Vertically oriented along the right side of the toothpaste tube, reading upwards. Size: Medium. Weight: Regular. Case: All lowercase. Colour: Dark charcoal grey. Font style: Sans-serif. Alignment: Center. No background.
"Helps control plaque buildup" position: Left side of the canvas, approx. 20% from left edge, 40% from top edge. Size: Medium. Weight: Regular. Case: Sentence case. Colour: Dark charcoal grey. Font style: Sans-serif. Alignment: Left. No background.
"Supports long-term oral health" position: Left side of the canvas, approx. 20% from left edge, 65% from top edge. Size: Medium. Weight: Regular. Case: Sentence case. Colour: Dark charcoal grey. Font style: Sans-serif. Alignment: Left. No background.
"Freshens breath naturally" position: Right side of the canvas, approx. 20% from right edge, 55% from top edge. Size: Medium. Weight: Regular. Case: Sentence case. Colour: Dark charcoal grey. Font style: Sans-serif. Alignment: Right. No background.
"Fang Toothpaste" position: Bottom center of the canvas, approx. 85% from top edge. Size: Large. Weight: Bold. Case: Title case. Colour: Dark charcoal grey. Font style: Sans-serif. Alignment: Center. No background.
"Confidence starts with your smile." position: Bottom center of the canvas, immediately below "Fang Toothpaste". Size: Medium. Weight: Regular. Case: Sentence case. Colour: Dark charcoal grey. Font style: Sans-serif. Alignment: Center. No background.

4. PRODUCT:
What it is: A white toothpaste tube with a crimped bottom and a screw-top cap.
Where it sits: Centered horizontally, occupying the middle 60% of the canvas height, with its base resting just above the bottom 18% band.
Approx % of canvas height: 55%.
Angle: Front-on view, standing upright, with a slight tilt to the right.
Lighting: Soft, even, studio-style lighting from the front-top.
Shadow/reflection: A subtle, soft, dark grey shadow directly beneath the base of the tube. No reflection.
Held or standing: Standing.

5. PEOPLE / PROPS / SCENE:
People: None.
Props: A small cluster of fresh green mint leaves.
Props position: At the base of the toothpaste tube, slightly to the right, partially overlapping the tube's bottom edge.
Camera angle and lens feel: Eye-level perspective for the toothpaste tube, slightly elevated for the mint leaves. Clean, sharp focus on the product and props, with a very subtle, soft blur on the background elements if they were not flat.

6. GRAPHIC DEVICES:
Five stars: Positioned horizontally centered below the "anymore." text, approx. 28% from the top edge. Colour: Bright yellow.
Three curved arrows:
First arrow: Originates from below "Helps control plaque buildup" text, curves right and slightly upwards, pointing to the top-left portion of the toothpaste tube. Colour: Black.
Second arrow: Originates from below "Supports long-term oral health" text, curves right and slightly upwards, pointing to the bottom-left portion of the toothpaste tube. Colour: Black.
Third arrow: Originates from below "Freshens breath naturally" text, curves left and slightly downwards, pointing to the middle-right portion of the toothpaste tube. Colour: Black.

7. COLOUR PALETTE:
Background: Light mint green (approx. #C8E8DD).
Text: Dark charcoal grey (approx. #333333).
Stars: Bright yellow (approx. #FFD700).
Toothpaste tube: White (approx. #FFFFFF).
Mint leaves: Vibrant green (approx. #4CAF50).

8. MOOD / FINISH:
Lighting: Bright, clean, and evenly diffused, suggesting a studio environment.
Contrast: High contrast for text against the background, moderate contrast for the product and props.
Photo vs render: The toothpaste tube and mint leaves appear to be high-quality photographs. The background is a flat graphic.
Any filter or grain: No discernible filter, grain, or texture. The image has a very clean, polished, and modern finish.

CHANGES REQUESTED BY THE ART DIRECTOR (the ONLY deliberate differences from the reference — apply exactly, nothing more):
REFERENCE = Fang bad-breath ad (benefits with hand-drawn arrows around a centred product, tagline under it). Build a LACALUT SENSITIVE ad with THIS layout, 4:5 portrait. TEXT SIZE BEATS IMAGE SIZE: every text line big and bold, readable at thumbnail size.
BACKGROUND: soft pale teal-aqua #E3F2F3 (NOT the reference's mint green), subtle soft glow behind the product, dark navy #12284C text and LACALUT red #C8102E highlight words.
TOP, FULL WIDTH (edge to edge with small side margins, about 33% of the height, the whole card including its bottom rows): the FIRST EXTRA attached image is a finished Facebook comment card (white card, avatar, grey bubble, bold name, FIVE GOLD STARS under the name, review text, reaction pill with count, "2w Like Reply", "View 7 replies"). Use it EXACTLY as supplied INCLUDING the bottom rows "2w  Like  Reply" and "View 7 replies" which MUST stay visible (never crop them off, never trim the card), pixel-copied, never redrawn, retyped, re-spelled - every word and element identical - only scaled up to span the full width.
MIDDLE (about 42% of the height): the attached product image (the SECOND image) = LACALUT sensitive toothpaste tube leaning at left and the sensitive mouthwash bottle with its box behind it at right, together. Place EXACTLY as supplied, centred, pixel-copy every pack, do NOT redraw, rotate, flip, mirror or add products. FOUR hand-drawn curved arrows in dark navy, each from a benefit label to the product, labels bold dark navy, large; the words in [RED] are LACALUT red #C8102E, everything else navy:
 - Left, upper (arrow to the tube): "Helps soothe [RED]sharp pain[/RED] from hot, cold & sweet"
 - Left, lower (arrow to the tube): "Helps rebuild and strengthen [RED]tooth enamel[/RED]"
 - Right, upper (arrow to the bottle): "[RED]Instant comfort[/RED] rinse for sensitive teeth"
 - Right, lower (arrow to the bottle): "Gentle, soothing care for [RED]receding gums[/RED]"
BOTTOM (about 20% of the height): headline in heavy bold dark navy, centred, THREE LINES, VERY LARGE: line 1 "Don't Ignore" line 2 "Sharp Tooth Pain." line 3 "Give Them The German Care." Leave clear breathing room between the headline and the bottom-right corner. The SECOND EXTRA attached image = the real LACALUT "100 YEARS" logo (red, lips mark, "DENTAL EXPERTISE SINCE 1925"): BOTTOM-RIGHT CORNER, small (about 18% of the canvas width), pixel-copied exactly, never redrawn, clear of the headline (no overlap). Leave a small empty space immediately to the LEFT of the logo.
NO stars row outside the review card, NO Trustpilot, NO headline above the review, NO CTA button, NO price. Remove all Fang branding and the "Tap to learn more" / FANGORAL link bar.

LACALUT PRODUCT (from the SECOND attached image onward): reproduce the real packaging EXACTLY — shape, label layout, colours, logo and wording; real proportions (a tall slim 75ml tube, never squat); only the LACALUT wordmark and variant name may read clearly, all small printed pack text stays in its ORIGINAL GERMAN and softly out of focus — NEVER legible English health words on the pack. Never invent, add or duplicate any other product, tube, box, bottle or brush. STRICT COMPLIANCE (cosmetic-only, non-negotiable): never show or write gingivitis, periodontitis, gum disease, halitosis, reverses the condition, graphic bleeding gums close-up, bleeding, reduces bleeding, stops bleeding, stops gum bleeding, gum bleeding, soothes, soothes irritation, irritation, inflammation, reduces inflammation, anti-inflammatory, heals, calms, closes gum pockets, kills bacteria, kills the bacteria, clinically proven, clinically tested, clinical trial, gum health, oral health, dental health, healthy tissue, healthy gums, dentist approved, dentist recommended, pain relief, pain-free cure, therapeutic; never a medical cross, never a disease or treatment claim, never "clinically proven", never a doctor endorsement unless the reference's equivalent line was explicitly rewritten by the art director. If a competitor line would breach this, keep its size/position but soften the wording to a cosmetic feel/benefit. TITLE CASE ALL HEADERS (Quan's #1 header rule, never break): the headline AND every sub-headline are written in Title Case — capitalise every significant word; small words (a, an, the, and, or, in, of, to, for, with, on, at) stay lowercase unless they are the first word. This overrides the reference ad's own casing (even if their headline is in sentence case). Body lines and fine print keep the casing given in the changes. TEXT RULES: all text in Australian English, spelled exactly as given, crisp and legible at thumbnail size. Do NOT add any headline, badge, trust seal, star row, review, CTA pill, URL, price or logo that the reference does not have. Do NOT remove any element the reference has. OUTPUT FORMAT — ALWAYS 4:5 PORTRAIT (1080×1350), even when the reference is square or landscape (Quan 15/10/2026, never break). Keep the reference's element order and styling top to bottom, and use the extra vertical space to make the main elements BIGGER — never add new elements, never leave an empty band. 4:5 portrait aspect ratio, full-bleed edge to edge. Output ONE finished image.
